Ports

Every app Inglenook is ported to, and the ones planned. Each port ships Inglenook Day and Inglenook Night from the same palette, with a step-by-step install guide. Apps differ in how much they let a theme change, so each port says how far it gets:

  • Tier 1, Full: the complete palette
  • Tier 2, Partial: most of the palette, with some gaps
  • Tier 3, Minimal: background, accent, and status colors

No port list found. Build the site with pwsh build/site.ps1 and open _site/ports/, or browse the Ports folder on GitHub.
